instruction: Set the editor font size to 16 in VS Code.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VS Code Settings, searched for 'wrap tabs', found the Workbench > Editor: Wrap Tabs setting, and enabled it by checking the checkbox in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code settings UI, search settings by keyword, toggle boolean checkbox settings
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same settings navigation capability but with a numeric input field instead of a checkbox toggle. Font size requires typing a value rather than just clicking a checkbox.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor.fontSize to 16 in VS Code settings. Evaluator reads settings.json from VM and checks that editor.fontSize equals 16 using the standard check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VS Code user settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json via get_vm_file

Metric check_json_settings correctly receives rules dict via get_rule (expected.type='rule'), accesses expected['expected'] to get {'editor.fontSize': 16}, and verifies all key-value pairs exist in the parsed JSON
Expected value 'editor.fontSize': 16 exactly matches the instruction requirement to set editor font size to 16
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (set font size to 16) is fully verified by the evaluator
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file returns file path (str) → check_json_settings opens and parses JSON → compares against expected key-value pairs

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
